description: Source code for a firmware utility library related to TP-Link devices, including functions for firmware image manipulation, MD5 checksum calculation, and file handling.

methods.name: find_layout
methods.description: Finds a flash layout by ID from a list of layouts.

methods.name: get_md5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 checksum of given data.

methods.name: get_file_stat
methods.description: Retrieves file size information for a given file.

methods.name: read_to_buf
methods.description: Reads file content into a buffer.

methods.name: build_fw
methods.description: Builds a firmware image by combining kernel and root filesystem, with optional padding and headers.
